paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah akum sawm-le-li kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria gam kumpipa Sennakerib tuh Judah gam a kulh nei khua tengteng sim ding in ava hohtou a alata hi.
heading: Isaiah Leh Hezekiah / (2 Kum 18.13-27; 2 Kro 32.1-19)
english: Now it happened in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah, and captured them.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Lakish a kipan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah sepaihhon tampipi toh Rabshakeh asawl hi. Huan dil saknung tuilakna kiang a Puansawpmi Loubuk lamlian ah adingh hi.
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah akiang ah ahong suk uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder came out to him.

paite: Huan Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah huchi in gen un, 'Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na muanna kingakna bang ahi mai a?'
heading: Assuria In Jerusalem Avauna
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

paite: Kidouna ding a na lemtheihna leh na hatna zaw thu lel ahi, ka chi. Kua muang a, ka tung a hel na himai a?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

paite: Ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun kitan Aiguptate muang na hi ve; huai mi na muanleh, na khut ah asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ah zaw amah muangte tung ah huchibang ahi.”
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

paite: Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh," na chihleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judahte kiang ah leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Hiai maitam ma ah kia na biak ding uh ahi," chi a, amun sangte leh amaitamte lakmangsakpa hilou hia?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar?’”

paite: Huchi in hehpih in, ka pu Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thu chiam in, huchi in ke'n sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding, nang atung ua tuang dingte na muh theih peuh dingleh.
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

paite: Bangchi in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu ah Aiguptate tung a na muanna nga a, ka pu sikha neupente lak a heutu khat leng na nan zoh ding?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

paite: Huan hiai hihse ding a sim ding in TOUPA pang lou a hong paitou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N, ka kiang ah, "Huai gam sim ding in hohtou inla, hihsia in, ahon chi, chi un," achi hi.
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

paite: Eliakim leh Shebna leh Joahte'n, Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai ka theithei ngal ua; kulhbaang tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uhi.
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

paite: Himahleh Rabshakeh in, "Ka pu in na pu kiang kia ah leh nang kiang ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulhbaang tung a tute, noute toh amau ek ne ding leh amau zun dawn dingte kiang ah, ahon sawl ahi zaw kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupi Assuria kumpipa thute ngaikhia un.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om nuam dah un; ama'n lah ahon humbit thei kei ding hi.
english: Thus says the king, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N pel lou in hon humbit ding; hiai khopi zaw Assuria kumpipa khut a piak in a-om kei ding, chi in thu gen mahleh, Hezekiah gen ziak in TOUPA muang nuam tuan dah un.' "
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

paite: Hezekiah thu ngaikhe kei un; Assuria kumpipa'n lah hichi in achi ngal a, "Thilpiak in hon kituahpih unla, ka kiang ah hong paikhia un; michih in agrepgui a pan leh michih in atheipi kung a pan ne chiat unla, michih in atuikhuk a pan tui dawn chiat un.
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for thus says the king of Assyria, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

paite: Ka hong pai a, noumau gam bang a buh leh uain omna gam, tanghou leh grephuante omna gam a ka hon paipih matan.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

paite: TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a, Hezekiah in ahon khem khakleh pilvang un. Namte pathiante'n Assuria kumpipa khut a pan agam uh ahumbit ngei ua hia?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

paite: Hamath leh Arpahte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Sepharvaimte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Huai Samaria khua kei a kipan in ahumbitta ua ahia?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

paite: Huai gam pathian tengteng lak a kuate'n ahia kei a kipan agam uh ahumbit uh? TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a kipan in ahumbit mahmah ding maw? chi in," achi hi.
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

paite: Amau bel adai dide ua, "Thu khat lel in leng adawng kei uh; kumpipa thupiak, amau dawng kei un," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n a uansilh uh botkek in Hezekiah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
